extracted.name: Strawberry Spinach Salad
extracted.description: This delicious strawberry spinach salad is perfect for spring and summer! The strawberries, greens, and tangy poppy seed dressing make it taste super bright and fresh. Feel free to assemble it up to 1 day ahead if you're making it for a potluck or special occasion. Just wait to add the dressing until right before serving!
ingredient_lines: ⅓ cup thinly sliced red onion
Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, place the spinach, strawberries, and red onion. Add some of the dressing and toss to combine.
Add the pecans and feta and gently toss. Add more dressing, as desired. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve.
